$comment: Generated by tools/asset-forge/real/fetch_real_assets.mjs --write. Every visible asset in the world is a real, licensed, pre-modelled GLB. tools/asset-forge/gate/real_asset_checks.mjs fails the build if a file is missing, edited, or sits in game/assets/world/real without an entry here.

kenney-space-kit.title: Kenney Space Kit
kenney-space-kit.author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
kenney-space-kit.notes: Authored low-poly sci-fi kit: hangars, gates, turrets, dishes, machines, platforms, rocks, crystals, corridors. Self-contained GLB conversions by the mirror maintainer, also CC0. Extended 2026-10-26 with 66 cinematic additions (monorail, rocket, rover, rail, extra platforms/pipes/terrain) from same source for dramatic sci-fi.

kenney-modular-space.title: Kenney Modular Space Kit
kenney-modular-space.author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
kenney-modular-space.notes: 40 modular sci-fi interior tiles: corridors, wide corridors, transitions, junctions, rooms, gates with lasers, stairs, templates. CC0. Fetched 2026-10-26 for cinematic Blade Runner / Destiny-like corridors and gate arches — dramatic volumetric interiors, not procedural geometry.

kenney-space-station.title: Kenney Space Station Kit
kenney-space-station.author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
kenney-space-station.notes: 97 sci-fi station interior props: containers, computers, displays, doors, balcony floors. CC0. Curated 18 pieces 2026-10-26 for lived-in dramatic set dressing and cinematic interior layers.

babylon-powerplant.title: Power Plant
babylon-powerplant.author: Kammertonus (https://twitter.com/Kammertonus)
babylon-powerplant.notes: Photoreal industrial power station: 285 meshes, 79 PBR materials, 65 baked 1024 px texture maps, 113,937 triangles.

derived-setpieces.title: Power Plant set pieces
derived-setpieces.author: Kammertonus (https://twitter.com/Kammertonus)
derived-setpieces.notes: Individual structures cut out of the Power Plant file (tank ring, tank pad, cooling tower, arch ribs, a single column, the drone, the crane carriage). Node hierarchy, materials and baked 1024 px maps are copied unchanged by real/slice_setpieces.mjs; nothing is modelled or re-textured.

kenney-nature.title: Kenney Nature Kit
kenney-nature.author: Kenney (www.kenney.nl)
kenney-nature.notes: Curated set of 33 models: pines and broadleaf trees, bushes, grass, moss, flowers, mushrooms, logs, boulders, and the grass/path ground tiles. The canopy layer of the Verdant Bloom world is built from these.

babylon-ground.title: Tiled ground plate
babylon-ground.author: Kammertonus (https://twitter.com/Kammertonus)
babylon-ground.notes: Real photographed stone-tile ground with baked PBR normal/diffuse/roughness maps at 1920 px. Used as the world floor: the tiles are geometry from the file, not a generated plane.
